spans.s: + अधर खण्डित- + अधर, adj., f. रा, with bitten lips, Pañc. 46, 1.
खणखणाय, a denomin. derived from खणखणा (a reduplicated imitative sound) by य, Ātm. To rustle, Bhāg.

खण्ड्,
 I. † i. 1, Ātm.
 II. i. 10, Par. (rather a denomin. derived from the next),
 1. To cut to pieces, Pañc. 47, 5.
 2. To break, Vikr. d. 19.
 3. To bite, Pañc. 46, 1.
 4. To destroy, Hit. ii. d. 107.
 5. To cause to cease, to satisfy,

.
 --With the prep. वि वि,
 1. To dismember, Pañc. iv. d. 60.
 2. To trouble, Bhāg.

खण्ड, m. and n.
 1. Breaking up,

. (The sense is: You alone are able to avert this breaking up of the kingdom, [which is] like a bridge broken by a great torrent of water, etc.).
 2. A piece.
 3. A part.
 4. The section of a work.
 5. A group,

.
 II. n.
 1. Hurting, Pañc. 45, 11.
 2. Violation, Pañc. 46, 3.
 3. Deceiving, baffling, Hit. ii. d. 58.

खाण्डव, i. e. खण्ड् + उ + अ, m.
 1. Sweetmeats,
खाण्डवायन, i. e. खण्डु, or खाण्डव + आयन, m. pl. A tribe of Brāhmaṇas,
खाण्डविक, i. e. खाण्डव + इक, m. A confectioner,
+ प्रस्थ खाण्डव- + प्रस्थ, m. the name of a town.
